dataChanges.description: The installer appends the four fixed rules to the target root .gitignore and binds the resulting bytes in the existing bootstrap receipt.

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing external --bootstrap-ignore-plan schema. For the exact managed leaf pair under a real root directory, require Git to attribute the parent exclusion to the literal .subactor/ rule in the committed root .gitignore. Append !/.subactor/, /.subactor/*, !/.subactor/.gitignore and !/.subactor/manifest.json in that order to the normal ignore projection. Refuse child ignore content that could override the projection during installation. Revalidate the same plan bytes and projection at the existing installer write boundary.
interfaceChanges: Extend the existing --bootstrap-ignore-plan behavior for the exact root .subactor/ layout.
architecture.rollback: Revert the three source changes through the governed review process. Preserve target receipts and operational state for owner reconciliation.

nonGoals: General excluded-directory exceptions, changes to ordinary upgrades or force-staging recipes.
Changes to the hub's ignore files or release metadata, consumer rollout or changes to ownership, lease, receipt and protected publication controls.
delivery.outcome: Extend the owner-reviewed bootstrap ignore plan so the two managed root .subactor files become trackable and the existing first ticket allocation can proceed.

validation.evidence: Real Git check-ignore results for the two literal leaves and a byte-for-byte comparison of the original ignore file with the prefix of the installed file.
Real Git check-ignore results for the protected and nested paths, including an unknown child created after installation, and byte comparisons for existing operational files.
Negative fixture assertions establish refusal before writes. Existing leaf, excluded-parent and pre-write race regressions pass.

The fixture verifies read-only preflight, installed lock and receipt bindings, and canonical allocation with the exact dirty digest. Only external release verification is stubbed in the fixture. Publication requires the managed gate and independent protected checks. At the accepted base the hub gate passed. The separate wellman check reported unresolved ticket activity in the disjoint ticket-475 worktree.

summary: Support owner-reviewed first native allocation when the root .gitignore excludes .subactor/.
